prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Desktop Pet", "Continue with Existing Account & Restore Pet", "Your pet data is automatically linked to your account email."]
1: ["Next, choose your pet's personality traits before customization."]
2: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion...", "Preparing desktop render engine...", "Your pet will automatically anchor to your primary desktop monitor once ready."]
3: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Control your pet anytime from the system tray or desktop hotkeys.", "Essential Desktop Shortcuts", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet. Right-click taskbar icon for settings."]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Companion"]
5: ["For best results, use well-lit photos with a clear view of your pet's face.", "Avoid blurry images or photos with multiple pets."]
6: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud Account", "Signing in ensures your pet settings, memory, and customization are never lost if you switch devices.", "Already created a pet? Sign in with the same email to restore it."]
7: ["Unlocked: First Day Desktop Ribbon!", "Claim Accessory & Complete Setup"]
8: []
9: ["Play chime when pet arrives"]
